cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.
